```

```

Also, app/meta.go needs a `SetMetadata(m fyne.AppMetadata)` function per the spec, not just NewWithMetadata. The requirement states: "In the app sub-package (app/meta.go), provide a SetMetadata(m fyne.AppMetadata) function that overrides the packaged metadata at runtime."

Please fix Target 1 before continuing with remaining targets.
